column3: NKJV has “saw,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “were seeing.”
NKJV includes “to the disciples, and the disciples,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “He distributed to those reclining.”
NKJV names “Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the sign He did.”
NKJV has “Jesus had not come,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “had not yet come.”
Close to the Greek; “twenty-five or thirty stadia” is rendered “three or four miles.”
NKJV has “they willingly received Him”; the Greek says “they were willing to receive Him,” and the meaning is uncertain.
NKJV includes “except that one which His disciples had entered,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “except one.”
Close to the Greek; “work for” is rendered “labor for.”
